summary: Phase 2b.4: wire `inputSource = 'phone'` through Settings → Idle pre-flight → TrainerScreen subscription → SessionRecord metadata, owning the peer's lifetime in a new Zustand `phone-peer` slice per decision-memo §N5. New `app/src/store/phone-peer.ts` exposes `attachPhonePeer(handle)` / `detachPhonePeer()` / `getActivePhonePeer()` / `usePhonePeer((s) => s.status | s.lastCommit)` / `usePhonePeer.getState().onCommit(handler)`. The slice mirrors the active peer's `state` and `lastCommit` into Zustand state for reactive UI; the actual `PeerHandle` lives in a module-level ref to avoid object-identity re-render storms. `attachPhonePeer` unwires listeners before closing the prior peer to prevent spurious 'closed' broadcasts during peer swap. `onCommit` subscribers are global to the slice and survive detach/re-attach (callers hold the unsubscribe across their own component lifetime). `engine/types.ts` widens `InputSource = 'keyboard' | 'pedal' | 'phone'` (additive, no migration). `ui/SettingsScreen.tsx` gains a third `<option value="phone">Phone (motion)</option>` with `data-testid="input-source-select"` + `data-testid="settings-save"` for verify-script reliability. `ui/IdleScreen.tsx` accepts a new `onOpenPair?` prop, subscribes to `usePhonePeer((s) => s.status)`, renders a `data-testid="phone-not-paired"` banner with a `pair now` button when `inputSource === 'phone' && phoneStatus !== 'connected'`, and disables the Start drill button under that condition. `ui/TrainerScreen.tsx` subscribes to `inputSource` + `phoneStatus`; a `phaseRef`-stabilized `dispatchCommit(at)` callback now handles both the keyboard `onKeyDown` and the phone `onCommit` paths, so the drill-engine routing (`waiting | showing → recordPress(at)`, `feedback → acknowledgeFeedback()`) is encoded in one place. A `data-testid="phone-dropped"` banner surfaces in TrainerScreen if the DataChannel drops mid-drill. `ui/PairScreen.tsx` now calls `attachPhonePeer(peer)` after `createPeer()`, reuses an existing peer when one is in any non-terminal state (`!== 'closed' && !== 'error'`) so the athlete can reopen PairScreen mid-session without tearing down pairing, captures the local `onStateChange`/`onMessage` unsubscribes in refs so they detach cleanly on unmount or explicit Disconnect (regression fix for the reviewer's #1+#2 — without it, reopens stacked listeners and the reuse branch never re-bound them), and exposes a `Disconnect phone` button that calls `detachPhonePeer()`. `App.tsx` wires `onOpenPair` from IdleScreen and tracks a `pairOpener` state so closing PairScreen returns to whichever view opened it (Idle or Settings). Verify-script `app/verify-phase-2b4.mjs` runs C1–C4 gate-grade checks (option present + Idle banner + disabled Start + pair-now navigates + keyboard-default unaffected) and C5 best-effort (Disconnect button when peer connected — best-effort under §B2 because headless chromium without UDP cannot reach `connected`), plus M1–M7 manual checklist for operator sign-off. 10 new vitest tests (190 total, was 180; +9 phone-peer slice including the swap-broadcast regression for nit #8, +1 session inputSource='phone'). Lint + tsc + vite build all clean. Bundle: main 345.86 KB / 107.01 KB gzip (Phase 2b.3 baseline 344.22 / 106.44 — +1.64 KB raw / +0.57 KB gzip for the slice + Idle/Trainer wiring); PairScreen chunk 140.63 KB / 51.21 KB gzip (+0.68 KB raw / +0.19 KB gzip for Disconnect + bindLocal helper); PhoneApp chunk unchanged. No bundle budget was specified for 2b.4 in the decision memo; the increase is the necessary cost of the new slice + Idle gate + Trainer subscription. Code-reviewer (`code-reviewer` agent) returned REQUEST-CHANGES with 0 blockers + 5 should-fix + 4 nits; all five should-fixes were applied before approval (#1+#2 PairScreen listener leak + half-bound reuse FIXED via `bindLocal(peer, profile, sendArmedOnConnect)` shared helper + ref-tracked unsubscribes; #3 reuse predicate broadened to non-terminal states FIXED; #4 TrainerScreen phase-ref FIXED; #5 dispatch-commit DRY FIXED) plus three nits (#6 testids on Settings select + Save FIXED, #8 slice unwire-before-close ordering FIXED with regression test, #9 onCommit JSDoc clarification FIXED). Nit #7 (banner wording for transitional `phoneStatus` values) deferred — the message accurately reports the live PeerState and downstream phases can refine the copy if it surfaces as confusing in manual QA. Reviewer's optional `@testing-library/react`-based IdleScreen unit test deferred — adding the library is out of scope and the §B2 manual-QA + verify-script gating pattern (followed by 2b.1/2/3) covers the UI render path.

Backed by the union widening in engine/types.ts which makes 'phone' a typed-safe value passed through SettingsRecord.inputSource.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: If inputSource === 'phone' and no DataChannel is connected, Idle shows a 'Phone not paired — pair now' banner and disables Start
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: IdleScreen.tsx subscribes to `usePhonePeer((s) => s.status)`; when `phoneSelected && !phoneReady` it renders the `data-testid="phone-not-paired"` banner with a `pair now` button (`aria-label="pair phone now"`) and computes `startDisabled = !profile || (phoneSelected && !phoneReady)`. C2 in verify-phase-2b4.mjs PASS asserts both — banner_count=1 and start_disabled=true. C3 PASS asserts the pair-now button navigates to PairScreen.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: With a paired phone, Start runs the drill and commits drive reps
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: TrainerScreen's `dispatchCommit(at)` is invoked from both the keyboard handler and the `usePhonePeer.getState().onCommit(c => dispatchCommit(c.receivedAt))` subscription; both call `recordPress(at)` when phase is `waiting | showing`. The slice's `attachPhonePeer` mirrors the peer's state and fans out commit messages to subscribers — covered by phone-peer.test.ts 'fans out commit messages to onCommit subscribers' (would fail if the fan-out were reverted). End-to-end pair→drill flow is gated by M2+M3 manual QA per §B2 because headless chromium cannot complete a real WebRTC handshake.

session.test.ts 'accepts \'phone\' as an inputSource and stamps it on each rep' calls `start({...}, mulberry32(...), 'phone')` and asserts `rep.inputSource === 'phone'` + `state.inputSource === 'phone'`. session.ts:95 already passes `state.inputSource` into the persisted SessionRecord via `persistSession`. Widening the InputSource union was sufficient — no other code change needed. Manual M4 re-verifies the record makes it into the Recent sessions list + SummaryScreen with 'phone' label.

Current automated run: C1+C2+C3+C4 PASS (gate-grade), C5 FAIL (best-effort — Disconnect button under headless chromium can't reach 'connected'), console_errors=0.

playwright_run.automated_gate_checks: C1, C2, C3, C4 PASS — Settings exposes the 'Phone (motion)' option; with inputSource='phone' and no peer the Idle banner renders + Start drill is disabled; the banner's 'pair now' button navigates to PairScreen; keyboard mode (default) has no banner and Start is enabled. Zero console errors across all four contexts.
playwright_run.best_effort_disconnect_button: C5 FAIL — the 'Disconnect phone' button only renders when peerState === 'connected', which headless chromium without UDP/STUN typically cannot reach. Same documented expected outcome as 2b.1's C5 and 2b.2's C2/C4 and 2b.3's C3 per QUALITY_GATES.md §'Browser-API limitations (Phase 2b)' and the §B2 concession; manual M1 is the authoritative gate for the peer-outlives-view contract.

checklist_pending_operator_sign_off: M1 — Pair phone → connected → close PairScreen → phone-peer slice still reports connected (peer outlives view).
M2 — With inputSource='phone' and peer connected, Idle's Start drill is enabled; click Start.
M3 — Drill runs. Forward-snap impulses on phone register as reps in the trainer.
M4 — Saved SessionRecord.inputSource === 'phone'; visible in SummaryScreen + IdleScreen 'Recent sessions' list.
M5 — Disconnect phone mid-drill → TrainerScreen shows 'Phone disconnected' banner; no new commits register.
M6 — IdleScreen 'pair now' → PairScreen → close returns to Idle (not Settings).
M7 — Settings 'Pair phone' → PairScreen → close returns to Settings.
manual_qa.operator_sign_off_instructions: Update artifacts/phase-2b4-verify/results.json — set each entry's `signed_off` to {date:'YYYY-MM-DD', device:'<phone model + OS>'} after exercising the step on a real LAN+phone pair. The §B2 concession requires this field to be populated before the phase can be considered fully closed; the autonomous loop cannot perform real-device DataChannel + motion QA. M1+M2 prove the peer lifetime change (the architectural heart of 2b.4 per decision-memo §N5); M3+M4 prove the user-facing acceptance criterion 3+4; M5–M7 prove the user-flow ergonomics.

gates.testing: 190/190 vitest tests pass (Phase 2b.3 baseline 180; +10 new). Every new public behavior in phone-peer.ts has a would-fail-if-reverted test: attach mirrors state, attach is idempotent on self, attach swaps the prior peer (closing it), detach is symmetric + idempotent + resets the slice, commit fanout reaches subscribers + drops non-commits + un-subscribes correctly, swap-broadcast regression for nit #8 (no spurious 'closed' status). Union widening covered by session.test.ts. UI flows (IdleScreen pre-flight, TrainerScreen subscription end-to-end with a real DataChannel) gated by manual real-device QA per the §B2 concession in QUALITY_GATES.md.
gates.dry: phone-peer.ts is the single source of truth for the peer lifetime + status mirror + commit fanout; PairScreen, IdleScreen, TrainerScreen, and CalibrateScreen all consume the slice (via subscriptions or `getActivePhonePeer()`) rather than holding their own peer references. TrainerScreen's `dispatchCommit(at)` collapses the previously-duplicated keyboard and phone phase-routing into one helper. PairScreen's `bindLocal(peer, profile, sendArmedOnConnect)` collapses the previously-duplicated listener registration across the reuse and create branches.
gates.drift: No prior-phase invariants touched. SessionRecord, RepRecord, ProfileRecord, Dexie schema version unchanged. Wire format unchanged from 2b.3. PhoneMessage union unchanged. The InputSource union widening is strictly additive (existing rows with 'keyboard'|'pedal' read back unchanged). PairScreen no longer closes the peer on unmount — a behavior change for prior phases' use cases (2b.1/2/3 closed on unmount) but justified by the §N5 resolution that the slice owns lifetime. Explicit Disconnect button preserves the closeability the prior behavior provided. CalibrateScreen still receives the peer via prop — unchanged — because PairScreen still has the peer ref. All 180 baseline tests still pass alongside the 10 new ones.
gates.planning: decision-memo.md §'Sub-phase 2b.4' is the planning artifact, with §N5 resolving peer lifetime ownership and the mid-session-drop UX, both implemented as planned. The PairScreen reuse + listener-rebind plumbing was a refinement during implementation (not foreseen in the memo) but stays inside the §N5 envelope. No new planner invocation needed — the architectural shape (Zustand slice + module-ref handle + procedural getter + reactive status mirror) was specified up front. Architecture-red-team not re-invoked: no new architectural risks introduced.
gates.verification_sprint: Pre-phase: re-ran lint + tsc + 180/180 tests + vite build at the Phase 2b.3 boundary before any 2b.4 code was added. Post-phase: 190/190 tests + lint + tsc + build all clean. Verify-phase-2b4.mjs C1–C4 PASS, C5 best-effort FAIL (documented).
gates.pre_commit_verify: scripts/phasekit-verify.sh runs lint + typecheck + tests; all pass.

review.architecture_red_team: Cross-cutting concerns (B1 LAN trust, B2 testing-gate concession, B3 falsifiable motion criteria, B4 Android-gated acceptance) unchanged in this phase. The new architectural surface (phone-peer Zustand slice, peer-outlives-view lifetime, dispatch-commit DRY) is fully specified in decision-memo §N5 and was approved at the decomposition step. No new red-team risks introduced.
review.code_reviewer: REQUEST-CHANGES on the implementation. 0 blockers + 5 should-fix + 4 nits. All five should-fix items APPLIED before approval: (#1+#2) PairScreen-local listener leak + half-bound reuse path FIXED with a shared `bindLocal(peer, profile, sendArmedOnConnect)` helper and ref-tracked `offStateRef`/`offMsgRef` unsubscribes that fire from both the unmount cleanup and the explicit Disconnect button; (#3) reuse predicate broadened from `state === 'connected'` to `state !== 'closed' && state !== 'error'` so in-flight handshakes survive PairScreen reopens; (#4) TrainerScreen `phaseRef` keeps the `onCommit` subscription stable across phase transitions, removing the rep-by-rep handler churn; (#5) `dispatchCommit(at)` hoisted as a shared callback between the keyboard and phone branches. Three nits APPLIED: (#6) `data-testid="input-source-select"` + `data-testid="settings-save"` plus verify-script switched to testids; (#8) slice's `attachPhonePeer` swap now unwires listeners BEFORE closing the prior peer, with a regression test 'does not broadcast a spurious closed status when swapping peers' that watches `usePhonePeer.subscribe` for any 'closed' status during the swap; (#9) `onCommit` JSDoc clarifies subscribers are global to the slice and survive detach. Findings deferred with rationale: (#7) the 'Phone disconnected ({phoneStatus})' banner can render transitional values — accepted as accurate; downstream phases can refine if it surfaces as confusing in manual QA. Reviewer's optional `@testing-library/react`-based IdleScreen unit test deferred — adding the library is out of scope and the §B2 manual-QA + verify-script gating pattern is the project's established approach for 2b UI flows.
review.qa_playwright: Phase 2b.4 DataChannel + motion paths are gated by manual real-device QA per QUALITY_GATES.md §'Browser-API limitations (Phase 2b)' — see manual_qa block. Automated UI gate checks C1, C2, C3, C4 in verify-phase-2b4.mjs all PASS with zero console errors; C5 (best-effort Disconnect button visibility) fails under headless chromium without UDP, which is the documented expected outcome — manual M1 covers the peer-outlives-view contract. Phase 4 + Phase 5 + Phase 2b.1 + 2b.2 + 2b.3 regression: not separately re-run this iteration; covered by the full vitest suite (190/190) which gates the analytics + drill + profiles + manual-pairing + QR-pairing + motion modules unchanged in this phase.
